title: SCP-594, Electric Sheep
description: Not every sheep is harmless, some carry a dangerous charge.
body:
Electric Sheep adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-594, also known as the Electric Sheep.


Unlike ordinary sheep, these anomalous creatures emit electric particles. They remain calm from a distance, but players who get too close or attempt to attack them will provoke the creature. SCP-594 can even randomly levitate for several seconds, and water becomes especially hazardous around them, shocking all entities nearby. Players can even shear the Electric Sheep to obtain Electric Wool. However, if a player feeds SCP-594 a cookie, it will let SCP-594 temporarily loses its electric abilities for 30 seconds and give only normal wool.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-058 spawn?

SCP-594 can spawn on the overworld surface like a normal monster, but in groups and won't despawn like an animal. However, there can only be a few instance of SCP-594 spawning natural in your world.

</details>



![SCP-594](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c241cfb067dde4cb4440d00baf3286f49be37fd.png)

SCP-594 most likely spawn in groups during the night, but doesnt despawn. It looks like a standard sheep with horns but sometimes emits electric sparks. Its passive until a player gets in a 2 block radius or attack it. It shocks nearby players upon contact. If in water, SCP-594 will shock every mob in a 6 block radius. On rare occasions, it levitates into the air for several seconds, due to it's electro-magnetic field. Shearing SCP-594 produces valuable yet hazardous Electric Wool which will also shock entities when walking on it. Feeding SCP-594 an cookie will calm the entity for 30 seconds, which means they won't emit Electric Shocks and shearing it, will give normal wool. Despite its familiar appearance, SCP-594 is no farm animal, approach it with caution.
